title: PARKED -- Pplr: migrate the twenty-script fleet
objective:
**PARKED by hv, 2026-08-10: Pplr is to be redone as a Rust project at some point; migrating the current shell fleet is not right for it. Nothing below executes; it stands as the survey record for the rewrite's benefit.**

Migrate Pplr (`~/Devel/prj/Pplr`, shell) -- the biggest and oldest migration of the thread (last release 2025-07): `bin/pplr` (70 lines) plus twenty `pplr_*` satellite scripts, each a candidate `bin/.devbin/cmd/<name>` handler. Its pre-commit hook runs raw `prettier --write` on staged Markdown, so the fence is the FIRST commit of the WP, before anything else.
body:
## Deliverables

- Fence commit first
- Inventory of all twenty-one scripts: disposition each, authored rulings extracted, and an explicit ruling per name that collides with a devbin builtin (`pplr_doctor`, `pplr_help`, `pplr_version`, `pplr_new`, ...)
- Install alongside; equivalence pack; `tests/*.bats` green through `bin/devbin`
- Switch on hv's explicit go; deletes last, satellite-by-satellite listed in the commit
- `Icon` cruft in bin/ handled only with case-sensitive `find -name`, never globs; untracked `templates/icons/` dirt parked and surfaced

## Dependencies

- WP-05 and WP-06 (shell shape twice-proven before the big one)
